1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web [[SVG13928760.06-27-2013.HIMZ8ZIGPXXIFW2.CLM_10914699.8.333.972.2112.1018.svg0.1535.93DrawingBlack and white]] and a pair of flanges extending from the web, the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, __the layer of adhesive comprising a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas.

3. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim1,wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas __and into interfacial layers between the first and second members and between the third member and each of the flanges__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric [[of the composite members are offset relative to each other]] __comprises plies on adjacent ones of the composite members that are offset relative to each other__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __the layer of adhesive including a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler__.

8. SVG13928760.06-27-2013.HIMZ8ZIGPXXIFW2.CLM_10914701.14.343.1886.2117.1930.svg0.1475.913GraphBlack and white bidirectional reinforcing fibers are graphite.

11. (Previously presented) The composite stiffener of claim7,wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, a titanium member.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __each of the three composite patches being separate from the others__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler.

14. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __generally C-shaped in cross section__.

20. (Original) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener, comprising: forming a composite structure having a web and a pair of flanges extending in opposite directions from the web, SVG13928760.06-27-2013.HIMZ8ZIGPXXIFW2.CLM_10914704.10.337.1204.2113.1251.svg0.1575.92ChemistryBlack and white laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; Joining a surface of the cap to the flanges; applying a layer of composite fabric to the surface of the cap joined to the flanges; placing a reinforcing filler between the web, the flanges and the cap; and, using an adhesive to Join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers on the composite structure and the cap.

21. (Original) The method of claim20,wherein: forming the composite structure includes forming the laminated tape plies into first and second channels, and 26 07-1127 82, 000-164 applying a layer of composite fabric over the laminated composite tape plies includes placing patches of the composite fabric on selected areas of the first and second channels.

22. (Original) The method of claim21,further comprising: placing a layer of composite fabric on facing surfaces of the each of the first and second channels; introducing an adhesive between the layers of composite fabric on the facing surfaces of the first and second channels; and, joining the first and second channels together at the facing surfaces.

23. (Original) The method of claim20,wherein using an adhesive to join the reinforcing filler to the composite fabric layers includes wrapping a layer of structural adhesive around the filler.

24. (Original) A method of fabricating a reinforced composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: forming multi-ply lay-ups of unidirectional composite tape; 27 07 -1127 82, 000-164 forming the lay-ups into first and second C-channels, a cap and a base; assembling the C-channels, the cap and the base into an I-section structure having a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web; applying composite fabric to surfaces of the C- channels, the cap and the base in areas forming radius filler zones at the intersection of the web with the cap and with the base; wrapping a reinforcing filler with a structural adhesive; placing the reinforcing filler and the adhesive in the radius filler zone; and curing the assembly.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite [[SVG13928760.06-27-2013.HIMZ8ZIGPXXIFW2.CLM_10914706.21.341.2329.2119.2377.svg0.165.927ChemistryBlack and white]] tape plies and having a web and first and second sets of flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a [[SVG13928760.06-27-2013.HIMZ8ZIGPXXIFW2.CLM_10914706.23.341.2555.2119.2603.svg0.165.927ChemistryBlack and white]] cap and a base, the web including radius areas between the web and the flanges and [[SVG13928760.06-27-2013.HIMZ8ZIGPXXIFW2.CLM_10914706.25.343.2777.2122.2825.svg0.165.93ChemistryBlack and white]] the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; __a layer of composite fabric on the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive surrounding the filler and joining__ the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
